# yapmod v0.4.0

This release introduces system tray support and built-in theme support!

### Fixed

- **AppImage compatibility on Linux:** On some Linux distributions, especially newer ones, the AppImage would fail to launch due to a dependency on `wayland-client.so`. These dependencies have been removed in an attempt to fix the issue. This hasn't been fully verified yet, so please open an issue if you still experience problems.

### New

- **System tray support:** yapmod can now stay running in the background when its window is closed, allowing notifications to continue working even when the application isn't visible. This should work on macOS, Windows, and most Linux desktop environments that support system tray indicators.

- **Theme support:** After several attempts, themes are finally here! You can now load custom themes directly into the application. The implementation is still a work in progress, but the core functionality is in place. Themes use a dedicated folder containing a CSS file and a `manifest.json` file rather than a standalone CSS file. The format and requirements are documented in the project documentation.

### Install

Download the build for your platform below.

macOS builds are ad-hoc signed but not notarized. The first time you open yapmod, right-click the application and select **Open** to launch it.
